label: In Aquinas' ST I q.3 a.4 first proof, each…, from Aquinas' first proof in ST I q.3 a.4… and 1 more
meaning: A source-attributed conditional transcription of ST I q.3 a.4's first proof, with both substantive causal premises left open. The two premises together exclude sufficient efficient self-causation by essential principles alone in the only proposed alternative to another actual efficient cause of esse. Nothing here proves that those are the only metaphysically possible explanation types; the omission models test that independently. No root-premise discharge.
